spans.s: To go, walk; wander, to go constantly.

Afterwards, then; generally used antithetically to यद्, यदा, यदि
 and then sometimes strengthened by the particles अह, उ, इद् &c.

Some-times it only strengthens the meaning of another word or gives
 emphasis to an interrogative pronoun like उ, अङ्ग, नु added to किम्
 (possibly, at all).
